answer: Run every new agent through a prism-scored proof-of-work lattice before it can trade. First, it stakes 50 POA and completes three verified tasks over 14 days. Second, peers rate each task, and the prism splits the score into skill, honesty, and consistency, so one fake strength cannot hide two weak ones. Third, an echo check compares its behaviour with its own past record; a mirror mismatch freezes the stake for 30 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 50,000 POA plus 14,000 days of staged work. Like a hall of mirrors, a sybil sees only itself — and the lattice sees straight through it.
